item: The two OSM CLI loops under a cleanup finally keep their back-edge inside the try (R163)
summary: ingest_country's per-object loop and reference_run._run's per-phase loop ended in a bare if, so on CPython 3.13 their back-edge sat outside the exception table of the try whose finally closes the location store / deletes the throwaway store; an interrupt there skipped the cleanup. Each loop's last statement is now a guard clause (same body, same behaviour). tests/test_r163_osm_loops.py reads the compiled code with the dis helper of test_gates_survive_an_interrupt.py and is red with the old loops (2 failed on origin/main's src/osm).
